description: This file defines the implementation of the 'Scope' class used in a build system or configuration context, including methods for managing variable values, templates, dependencies, and scope hierarchy.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Represents a variable and template scope in a build configuration system, supporting nested scopes, variable management, and dependency tracking.

classes.name: Scope::MergeOptions
classes.description: Options for merging scope data, including flags for clobbering existing values, skipping private variables, and marking destination variables as used.

classes.name: Scope::ProgrammaticProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing programmatically defined values to a scope.

classes.name: Scope::TemplateInvocationEntry
classes.description: Represents an invocation of a template within a scope, including template name, target name, and location.

methods.name: Scope::DetachFromContaining
methods.description: Detaches the scope from its parent, collecting build dependency files.

methods.name: Scope::GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value by name, considering programmatic providers and scope hierarchy.

methods.name: Scope::SetValue
methods.description: Sets a variable value in the scope.

methods.name: Scope::RemoveIdentifier
methods.description: Removes a variable from the scope.

methods.name: Scope::AddTemplate
methods.description: Adds a template to the scope if it does not already exist.

methods.name: Scope::GetTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template by name, searching parent scopes if necessary.

methods.name: Scope::CollectBuildDependencyFiles
methods.description: Collects build dependency files from the scope and its ancestors.

methods.name: Scope::CheckForUnusedVars
methods.description: Checks for variables that were set but not used, reporting errors.

methods.name: Scope::MakeClosure
methods.description: Creates a flattened copy of the scope, merging nested scopes.

methods.name: Scope::MakeTargetDefaults
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a target defaults scope for a specific target type.

methods.name: Scope::GetTargetDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves target defaults scope for a specific target type.

methods.name: Scope::SetProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Marks the scope as processing a build configuration.

methods.name: Scope::IsProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Checks if the scope or its ancestors are processing a build configuration.

methods.name: Scope::SetProcessingImport
methods.description: Marks the scope as processing an import.

methods.name: Scope::IsProcessingImport
methods.description: Checks if the scope or its ancestors are processing an import.
